T: Be our guest. Try the grey stuff.
D: A young woman held in an enchanted castle sees past the Beast to the man inside.
P: Serve the snacks during Be Our Guest.
S: The grey stuff cookies and cream mousse
Lumière's dinner show for Belle, ask the dishes

Silky cookies and cream mousse of crushed chocolate biscuits, whipped cream and mascarpone, piped into little cups and topped with a crunchy biscuit crumb. Crush 12 chocolate cream sandwich biscuits, keeping 2 tbsp crumbs. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 250g mascarpone, 2 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla to soft peaks. Fold through the crushed biscuits so it turns grey. Pipe into 8 small cups or glasses and chill 1 hour. Top with the saved crumbs and a white chocolate curl just before serving.
he eats five dozen eggs every morning
Devilled eggs: boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a little butter, piped back, finished with paprika and chives. A dozen will do.
the baker in Belle's village song
Fresh baguette sliced, toasted with olive oil, topped with brie, sliced pear and a drizzle of honey.
M: the enchanted castle kitchen cooks dinner for Belle

Beef chuck braised slowly with bacon, baby onions, mushrooms, thyme and a rich grape and beef stock gravy, over buttery mash with crusty bread. Brown 150g diced bacon, then 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches. Cook 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp flour, then 250ml red grape juice, 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, thyme and bay. Return the meat, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Brown 12 peeled baby onions and 250g mushrooms in butter and stir in. Serve with mashed potato.
Chicken roasted at 220C then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes and a rich pan gravy, eaten with your hands.
W: the rose under the glass bell, losing its petals
Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm cream with sugar and a few drops of rosewater, set in glasses for 4 hours, topped with raspberries crushed with a little sugar and a single sugared rose petal.
K: the tavern where everyone sings about Gaston
Cloudy apple juice with a little lemon frozen in a tray, scraped into slush, topped with a toasted marshmallow foam of whipped cream folded with marshmallow creme. Mrs Potts's tea for the grown-ups.

s.note: he eats five dozen eggs every morning
s.how: Boil 12 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and halve. Whip the yolks with 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and 20g soft butter until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and finish with smoked paprika and chives.

s.note: the baker in Belle's village song
s.how: Slice a baguette, brush with olive oil and toast at 200C for 8 minutes. Top each slice with 200g sliced brie and a thin slice of pear from 2 pears. Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter and salt. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes, with 1kg potatoes in the tray. Rest, then make gravy with the pan juices, thyme and 300ml stock. Tear it apart at the table.

w.note: the rose under the glass bell, losing its petals
w.how: Soak 3 gelatine leaves. Warm 600ml cream with 80g sugar, stir in the gelatine and a few drops of rosewater. Pour into 4 glasses and set 4 hours. Top with 150g raspberries crushed with sugar and a single sugared rose petal.

d.note: the tavern where everyone sings about Gaston
d.how: Freeze 1L cloudy apple juice with the juice of a lemon in a tray, scraping every 30 minutes for 3 hours. Fold 3 tbsp marshmallow creme into 150ml whipped cream and spoon on top. Brew a pot of English breakfast tea for the grown-ups.
